_doc: Enterprise analytic blueprint for India Power & Energy Sector — Enterprise Statistical Report v3. 6 topics, dense state-level power-sector data, 30+ page target.

templateMeta.name: India Power & Energy Sector — Enterprise Statistical Report v3
templateMeta.description: Enterprise power & energy sector report: installed capacity, source mix, generation, renewables, consumption, electrification, system losses, peak demand and cross-cutting regional indices.

dataSources: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

glossary.PLF: Plant Load Factor — ratio of actual to maximum possible generation.
glossary.T&D Losses: Transmission and distribution energy losses as a share of input.
glossary.Installed Capacity: Total rated generation capacity of all plants.
glossary.Renewable: Hydro, solar, wind and biomass capacity combined.
glossary.MNRE: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
